Helps children recognize different emotions and discover the reason behind the emotions. Empathy is considered to be one of the most important skills to create positive social change. It allows you to understand problems, communicate clearly, and develop meaningful relationships.

Nurturing Vocabulary:This illustrated book effortlessly introduce new words to your child, enriching their vocabulary and expanding their early language skills.

Ideal Gifts for Kids:Whether for your own child or as a meaningful gift for a kids birthday party or special occasions, this children's book offers both joy and enrichment.

Bonding Over Books:Create meaningful moments and deepen the bond between parents and children by reading this sam and mi picture book.
